title: Yale World Fellows Program 2027
institution: Yale University, Jackson School of Global Affairs (Maurice R. Greenberg World Fellows Program)
about: Leadership fellowship at Yale University running annually from mid-August to mid-December. Applicants submit a CV, personal statement, three recommendation letters and a brief video statement; a $20 application fee applies. Decisions are emailed by the end of April.
requirements: CV, personal statement, three letters of recommendation and a brief video statement
